start: Owner signed in online on the real gym; the bell top right shows a number

user_sees: A panel named 'Notifications'
Groups 'Your gym', 'From MettleUp' and 'What's new'
A 'New' tag on what was not seen before
must_not: The bell is shown in the demo gym
The list moves under the finger while it is open
A message from another gym in Your gym

steps.action: Close the panel (tap outside or press Escape) and look at the bell
user_sees: The number no longer counts the app updates and MettleUp messages just shown
must_not: The same updates counted as new again after a reload
Alerts that still wait for someone dropped from the number

user_sees: Title 'What's new'
Subtitle 'Changes to the admin app, newest first.' with the version
One card per day, newest first
A button like '<label> ›' under a change that has a page
must_not: A day card with no lines
A button that opens a page this person may not open

start: Owner on the real online gym; a new feature (not a fix) was released in the last 30 days and its page was not opened on this device

steps.action: Look at the left menu (or the phone bottom bar and More)
user_sees: A small dot on each entry on the way to the new feature
must_not: A dot for a fix
A dot for a feature released before this gym was set up
A dot for a page that is not in this person’s menu
A dot in the demo gym

steps.action: Follow the dots and open the page
user_sees: The dot next to the page heading stays while the owner is on the page
must_not: The dot stays on the menu after the page was opened and left
The dot comes back after a reload on the same device

start: Owner types the old address of What’s new (Settings → news)

user_sees: The same 'What's new' page
must_not: A blank page
A sign-out

start: Owner online; the server answer for MettleUp messages fails or is not a list

user_sees: The bell opens with the other groups; no 'From MettleUp' group
must_not: An error box or a broken bell
A message with a link that is not an admin page or an https address shown as a button
A count that never clears

start: Owner on a new browser that never opened the bell; MettleUp sent messages 5 days ago and 20 days ago

steps.action: Look at the bell without opening it
user_sees: The message of the last 14 days counts as new; the older one does not
must_not: Zero shown although a recent message was never seen
Every old message counted

steps.action: Open the bell, close it, wait for the next check (15 minutes) or reload
user_sees: No number for the seen message
must_not: The seen message counted again
A newer message not counted

start: Owner and a staff person use the same desk browser one after the other

steps.action: The owner opens the bell and the new feature pages; then staff signs in on the same browser
user_sees: Staff sees the bell with what is new for the gym; 'seen' marks are the browser’s, not the person’s
must_not: MettleUp messages needing a sign-in to read (the same words go to every gym)
A gym’s own data inside a MettleUp message
What the owner saw sent to the server as a reading record

start: Staff signed in online; the bell shows a number

user_sees: Panel 'Notifications' with 'Your gym', 'From MettleUp' and 'What's new'
must_not: Alerts meant only for the owner
A button to a page staff may not open (Expenses, Pay MettleUp, AI Assistant)

user_sees: Title 'What's new'; day cards, newest first
Lines about owner-only pages show as text with no button
must_not: A button that lands staff on a refused page

start: Staff signed in; a new owner feature was released yesterday

steps.action: Look at the menu and bottom bar
user_sees: No new-feature dots at all (dots are for the owner)
must_not: A dot that leads staff to a page they cannot open

start: Staff opened the bell earlier today; nothing new since

steps.action: Reload the panel and look at the bell
user_sees: No number for app updates and MettleUp messages already seen
must_not: Seen updates counted again
A 'New' tag on an old line
